cohort: 3006 nulliparous women living in Pennsylvania, USA
finding: Childbirth-related PTSD was consistently associated with lower levels of maternal-infant bonding over the course of the first year after first childbirth.
mod_finding: Labor induction, delivery complications, poor pain control, and unplanned cesarean delivery were associated with CR-PTSD, and women with CR-PTSD reported a less positive childbirth experience and less shared decision-making.
